text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion dominates at the Mile Championship! Although vexed by her loss, Kawakami Princess congratulates her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunderous applause and cheers of support echo throughout the venue. There's no way anyone's going to forget the dazzling victor of the princess showdown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this incredible race behind us, Fine Motion and I happily wonder what to do tomorrow. There are only a few months left before she goes back to Ireland… which means there's still time to enjoy Japan!
